social.officialPlanDesc: Official social plan hosted on behalf of an institution / host (protocol).
social.announceDesc: Select people from the participant list; the announcement is recorded on this plan and the plan moves to Announced.
social.noParticipations: No participation records in this edition — add participations from the Registration & Participants screen first.

floors.title: Floor Studio
floors.desc: Spatial booth plan — Maven holds the commercial record, geometry is shared via a common ID (boothUnitId) (§20)
floors.emptyTitle: No booths defined for this edition
floors.emptyDesc: Add booths from the Sponsor & Exhibition module; they are placed on the plan automatically.
floors.unplacedHint: {count} booths awaiting placement — shown dashed on the plan
floors.selectBooth: Select a booth on the plan
floors.noSelectionDesc: Pick from the plan or the awaiting-placement list.
floors.hintMaven: Maven keeps allocation/contract records; Floor Studio draws the geometry.
floors.hintDecor: Decor objects are owned by Floor Studio — Maven only displays them.
floors.geometryRemovedDesc: {code} removed from the plan (commercial record preserved).
floors.allPlaced: All booths are on the plan.
floors.autoArrangeDesc: {count} booths lined up on the plan

integrations.pageDesc: Bidirectional data flow hub — outbound calls, inbound webhooks and payment integrations.
integrations.listDesc: click a card → endpoint and masked auth detail
integrations.emptyDesc: Use 'New Integration' to open a payment, REST, webhook or mail channel — presets fill the fields.
integrations.providersDesc: Form Center online payments flow through PAYMENT kind integrations
integrations.providersBody1: Payment providers connect here — Form Center online payments flow through
integrations.providersBody2: kind integrations. Virtual POS credentials are stored masked, runs are logged.
integrations.logsEmptyDesc: Run an integration or send a webhook test — the stream appears here.
integrations.formDesc: Start from a preset — fields fill automatically.
integrations.noAuthHint: No fields for this type — write handshake details into notes.
integrations.hookNote1: A webhook address is generated on save:
integrations.hookNote2: — copy the address from the card.
integrations.tenantLevelDesc: Enable for edition-independent channels like payment providers.
integrations.deleteDesc: The integration and all run logs are permanently deleted. Calls already made to the external system cannot be undone — use "Pause" to pause instead.
integrations.copiedDesc: Copied to clipboard — share it with the external team.
integrations.webhookOkDesc: Result: {result} — new person + attendance chain ran.
integrations.draftInboundDesc: Webhook address ready — copy it from the card and give it to the external system; activate when ready.

compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.desc: KVKK erasure requests, jurisdiction profile, document register and a personal-data-free compliance report on a single screen.
compliance.actionFailed: The action could not be completed
compliance.ersSwept: {n} open request(s) older than 6 months were auto-completed (last-resort erasure).
compliance.ersListDesc: Public intake requests, SLA status and handling trail. Erasure = anonymization: participation and finance history stays under legal retention.
compliance.ersEmptyDesc: Requests arriving through the public KVKK intake channel are listed here.
compliance.ersVerifyOkDesc: Email was matched against records and linked when a person was found.
compliance.ersCompleteOkDesc: The person's identity fields were anonymized; historical records remain under legal retention.
compliance.ersRejectTooShort: Reject reason must be at least 10 characters
compliance.ersRejectDesc: A legal hold justification is required for {email}; the justification will be recorded.
compliance.ersRejectPh: e.g. invoice and accounting records must be retained for 10 years under tax law…
compliance.ersRetentionFallback: Erasures are anonymizations; operation logs are retained for 3 years.
compliance.jrPresetsDesc: Apply the TR (KVKK) or EU (GDPR) preset with one click; values can be freely adjusted afterwards.
compliance.jrPresetHint: Presets only write numeric and enum fields; notes are preserved.
compliance.jrPresetAppliedDesc: Jurisdiction profile updated and an op-log entry was written.
compliance.jrFormDesc: These values are configuration, not legal text. Every update is written to the personal-data-free op log.
compliance.jrSlaHint: At least 7 days; the KVKK and GDPR recommendation is 30 days.
compliance.jrDpoHint: A unit or person representing the data controller has been appointed (GDPR: DPO).
compliance.jrRetentionHint: Free-form summary — must not contain legal text.
compliance.jrInvalidSla: SLA must be at least 7 days
compliance.jrInvalidBreach: Breach window must be 24, 72 or 96 hours
compliance.jrInvalidOpLog: Op-log retention must be between 1 and 10 years
compliance.jrSavedDesc: Changes were applied to the profile and written to the op log.
compliance.docNewDesc: When a new version is saved, the previously active version of the same kind is archived automatically and marked as superseded.
compliance.docContentHint: If text is provided, a sha256 integrity digest is computed; otherwise the record is marked as linked (LINKED).
compliance.docSavedDesc: {kind} — v{version} was registered as the active version.
compliance.docEmptyDesc: Keep versions of documents such as the privacy notice, explicit consent and data retention policy here.
compliance.docActivateOkDesc: {kind} v{version} is now active; the previous active version was archived.
compliance.repEmptyDesc: The report could not be generated — try refreshing.
compliance.repNoPii: This report contains NO personal data
compliance.repNoPiiDesc: Only aggregate counts are shown; emails, names or identity details are never included under any circumstance (KVKK data minimization).
compliance.repErasureDesc: Aggregate view of the KVKK erasure request queue.
compliance.repConsentDesc: Minimal consent counts taken from registration surfaces (without reading identity data).
compliance.repDocsDesc: Versioned document records and single-active status.
compliance.repDocsActiveSub: at most one active per kind
compliance.repJurisdictionDesc: Active jurisdiction profile — only configuration values are reflected in the report.

portal.blocksSectionDesc: Add announcement, info or link blocks to the participant and sponsor portals — visibility and order are under your control.
portal.emptyDesc: Enrich the portal surfaces by adding an announcement, banner, info or link block.
portal.dlgCreateDesc: Define a content block that appears in the participant and/or sponsor portal.
portal.fldTextPh: Write the text to display on the portal…
portal.fldVisibleHint: Hidden from the portal when off.
portal.noParticipationDesc: Apply through the registration form and your participation will be created — you can follow its progress on this screen.
portal.hdrSubtitlePh: e.g. Registration, payments and your programme in one place
portal.firmIdentityHint: You can add this under Settings → Firm Identity.

accommodation.hTransportPh: Metro, bus, tram or valet details…
accommodation.hPortalFieldsHint: Compact info fields — everything shown here is entered by you and displayed on the accommodation card. No field is pre-filled.

badgeQueue.emptyQueueDesc: Badges are prepared automatically once a registration is approved (READY) and are listed here.
badgeQueue.clearFilterHint: Clear the status filter or your search.

editions.capsOpened: {n} capabilities enabled. You can change them anytime under Settings → Capabilities.

media.emptyAssetsDesc: Use 'Upload asset' to attach a file link, or embed small files directly into the archive.

registrations.title: Registrations & Participants
registrations.updatedAll: Person, participation and registration fields updated.

sponsorship.guestFlowDesc: Person → Participation → Registration(SPONSOR_ENTITLEMENT) → Claim(RESERVED) chain created. Approving does not consume it yet.

install.title: Install the app
install.desc: Add to your home screen and use it like a native app.
install.doneDesc: Your browser will show the install steps.

program.title: Agenda
program.empty: No published sessions yet — the agenda will appear here soon.

speakers.title: Speakers
speakers.empty: No speakers assigned to the program.

sponsors.title: Sponsors
sponsors.empty: No visible sponsors for this event.

map.title: Venue Map
map.empty: The floor plan has not been added yet — it will appear here once published.

qa.title: Q&A
qa.question: Your question
qa.authName: Your question is sent with your profile name.

b2b.title: My B2B Meetings
b2b.authOnly: This module is available to registered participants only
b2b.authOnlyDesc: Sign in with your e-mail details to see your personal B2B appointments.
b2b.reschedDesc: Briefly tell the organizer which times suit you.

done.RESCHEDULE: Your time request has been sent

profile.title: Profile
profile.guestDesc: If you have registered, you can sign in with the details sent in your e-mail.
profile.registerDesc: The registration form is still open — apply in minutes.
profile.guestRights: As a guest you can see the agenda, speakers, sponsors and floor plans. Identity-based voting, your personal B2B calendar and ticket details are available to registered participants.
profile.noRegs: No registrations — you have not created one yet.
profile.notifDesc: Session and appointment reminders ({offsets} min before) are delivered here.
profile.notifTestBody: You will see event reminders here.

reminder.disabledDesc: The organizer has disabled reminders for this event.

login.emailHint: Sign in with the address on your invitation e-mail to access tickets and B2B meetings.
login.codeHint: Enter with the event code shared by the organizer — the agenda, speakers and sponsors open up.

countdown.maintenance: The portal is under maintenance — please try again shortly.

game.title: Quests & Badges
game.disabled: Gamification is disabled for this event.
game.leaderEmpty: Nobody has points yet — be the first!
game.levelUpDesc: Congratulations — you are now at {level} level.

access.title: Access & Security Management
access.desc: Portal status, entry code and magic link management.
access.statusOn: Portal is active — participants can sign in.
access.statusOff: Portal is inactive — a maintenance message or countdown is shown.
access.maintPh: e.g. The portal is briefly under maintenance…
access.codeHint: Guest and e-mail entry open with this code. Empty disables code entry.
access.magicHint: Issues personal, single-display access keys for registered participants.
access.regRedirectHint: Shows the registration form button on the login screen and guest profile.

brand.title: Visual Configuration & Theme
brand.desc: Portal logo, banner, theme color and menu customization.
brand.headerSubtitlePh: e.g. Registration, program and B2B in one place
brand.headerEventsHint: Selected events appear in the top strip carousel for portal visitors. If empty, all published events are shown.
brand.bottomNavHint: Home and Profile are fixed; you can hide the others.
brand.imgSize: Image is too large — max {kb} KB

widgets.title: Dynamic Widget & Module Management
widgets.desc: Toggle home cards, assign visibility, reorder.
widgets.b2bLocked: B2B is locked to registered users by design

notify.title: Notification Management
notify.desc: Reminder triggers and the live announcement panel.
notify.enabledHint: Notifications are sent for B2B appointments and reminder-marked sessions.
notify.offsetsHint: How many minutes before the event/appointment the notification fires. Up to 5 triggers.

announce.title: Live Announcement Panel
announce.desc: Send instant announcements to all active portal users.
announce.titlePh: e.g. Coffee break has started in the main hall
announce.sentDesc: It reaches users with the portal open instantly.

content.title: Content Mapping
content.desc: Choose sponsors and the floor plan shown on the portal — data is not copied, it is linked to existing records.
content.sponsorsSelected: {count} sponsors selected — only selected ones appear on the portal
content.sponsorsAll: None selected — all active sponsors are shown
content.pwaHint: When PWA is on, the portal can be installed as an app on mobile browsers (add to home screen + offline shell).

analytics.title: Live Portal Statistics
analytics.desc: Unique visitors, widget clicks, PWA installs, form and B2B metrics.

magic.title: Magic Link / Access Code Generation
magic.desc: A personal access key is issued for each selected participant.
magic.onceWarning: Keys are shown ONCE only — copy and share them via a secure channel.
magic.sendMail: Also send via the mail module

design.title: Design & Typography
design.desc: All mobile portal design settings: font, area colors, background images (SVG/PNG/JPEG), sponsor logo and icon positions.
design.fontPreview: Headings and text across the mobile portal render with this font.
design.fontScaleHint: 100% is default; scales all portal text between 90–120%.
design.areaColorsHint: If left empty, that area falls back to the default theme color.
design.headerImgHint: Covered behind the top header and event title.
design.footerImgHint: Covered behind the fixed bottom nav.
design.sponsorDesc: Enter logo, name and web link — the sponsor strip appears above the bottom nav on all screens.
design.canvasDesc: Drag bottom-nav icons on the grid to reposition them; upload an SVG logo for any icon.
design.canvasHint: Drag & drop or use the arrows · You can upload an SVG (or PNG) logo for the selected icon.
design.widgetIconsDesc: Pick dashboard card icons from the library or upload SVG/PNG.
design.libraryDesc: Search and pick an icon — or upload your own SVG/PNG logo.
design.noResults: No results — try another word or upload one.
design.uploadDesc: Upload your own icon — SVG (recommended) or PNG, up to 300KB.

channels.title: Notification Channels — WhatsApp & SMS
channels.desc: Send notifications via WhatsApp and SMS through the connected company mobile phone. Secrets are stored encrypted and shown masked.
channels.masterHint: When off, no WhatsApp/SMS is sent; in-app notifications are unaffected.
channels.waDesc: Sent through a provider connected to the company mobile phone.
channels.smsDesc: SMS channel for announcements and reminders.
channels.demoNote: The demo provider never hits the network, it simulates the flow — pick a real provider in production.
channels.waFromHint: Company mobile number connected to WhatsApp (E.164).

chrome.title: Screen Top Bars
chrome.desc: Decide per screen whether the Maven top band and event title appear.
chrome.eventBarHint: Hero on Home, compact bar elsewhere
chrome.hint: Default: the Maven band appears only on Home; the event title on all screens. Disabled bars are not rendered on that screen at all.

game.title: Gamification
game.desc: Participants earn points and levels by completing forms and asking questions — leaderboard and badges for a native app feel.
game.enabledHint: When on, the 'Quests & Badges' card and game screen appear in the portal.
game.qaCap: Question point cap (how many questions earn points)
game.levelsHint: Thresholds must be ascending — passing a threshold levels the participant up with a confetti celebration.

questions.title: Q&A Moderation
questions.desc: Reply to or hide portal questions; replies appear in the participant question history.
